summary: CollPlant Biotechnologies filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report) attaching a press release dated November 11, 2026, announcing that its subsidiary LightSolver will publicly demonstrate its all-optical Laser Processing Unit at SC26 in Chicago on November 16-19, 2026, booth #5102. The release highlights paid Boeing corrosion-simulation work and an analog-computing BoF session. No price, stake, consideration, board recommendation, advisor or transaction terms are disclosed. This is a routine product/technology announcement, not a special situation.
